chosen_completion_path: Option B — Root cause found, separate repair needed

10_no_reply_acceptable_if_ledger_path_ot.basis: Safe closeout/dormancy is acceptable, but Ledger v0.1 completion cannot be claimed without sanitized delivery semantics.

1_retry_reached_handler.basis: before_agent_reply hook registered and cron trigger invokes it; armed/job/prompt/source checks match before drift check.

3_no_reply_due_malformed_closeout_payloa.basis: payload hashes/anchors were present and matched; closeout anchor was not the failing condition.

4_no_reply_due_runner_quiet_success.basis: runner treats exact NO_REPLY as silent delivery, but exact NO_REPLY came from boundary HOLD without reply.

5_no_reply_due_announce_insufficient.basis: announce was sufficient for non-empty final text; it had no payload after NO_REPLY normalization.

6_no_reply_due_terminal_anchor_missing_o.basis: terminal and closeout anchors were recorded present and message SHA matched expected.

7_no_reply_due_intentional_suppression_f.basis: Cron isolated jobs can announce; suppression is only exact silent-token behavior after boundary hold.

8_no_reply_due_surface_session_key_misma.basis: delivery target resolution was ok and cron isolated base session key matched expected `cron:<jobId>` contract.

9_sanitized_delivery_required_for_ledger.basis: M25E completion criterion was sanitized Context Bridge summary delivery; M25E-R only proved cleanup/no-rerun safety.

root_cause: The boundary handler fail-closed before rendering because Context Bridge events changed after M25E arming/preflight and before the forced retry. That produced HOLD_NO_DELIVERY with no reply; OpenClaw cron then normalized exact NO_REPLY as a silent final payload and did not announce to Telegram.
why_not_option_a: NO_REPLY is runtime-expected after a boundary hold, but sanitized delivery remains required for Ledger v0.1 completion.
why_not_option_c: A final proof would require a fresh one-shot job, protected arming/config mutation, Gateway reload, and external delivery. The safer M25F closeout is no-retry repair planning; final proof should be a separately approved milestone with context-freeze/just-in-time hash controls.
